register: Resampled reruns over 24 sampled realizations of the documented SURVEYSELECT GROUPS=10 randomization family x input-order conventions (11 structurally distinct candidate algorithms, seed 8675309, + 5 uniform-random equal-split draws random.Random(1000+i), on cid_asc dataset order; + 8 input-order variants: {seq_quota_last, sort_blocks_first} x {cid_desc, score_asc, score_desc} and 2 uniform-random draws (Random(1005), Random(1006)) on score_asc; the ordering feeds both the group assignment and the ward_tie observation numbering). Not a proof over all realizations. Clustering inputs: K-table basis vintages (2024/2025 original, 2026 current), stage-1 reconciled membership (cost+d60r+emp; removals dropped, adds appended). Baseline stars/ratings: operative published record (2024 recalc, 2025/2026 current). Arms: ward_tie (SAS tie-rule Ward replay) vs dp (exact SSQ optimum); identical groups, guardrails, rounding. CAHPS, improvement, and errored measure-splits held at published stars (conservative undercount). Errored splits excluded from all realizations.
